title: Shopping Addiction (Compulsive Buying)
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from shopping addiction, also
known as compulsive buying disorder . Recovery is a journey of developing self-control, healing emotional
triggers, building financial wellness, and discovering fulfillment beyond material possessions. These
affirmations encourage mindfulness, gratitude, resilience, and intentional living. They are intended to
complement professional counseling, financial planning, accountability, and healthy coping strategies.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Recovery from compulsive buying is about more than spending less-it is about understanding the
emotions behind the urge to shop and developing healthier ways to meet those needs. With
patience, self-compassion, financial planning, accountability, and professional support when needed,
lasting freedom is possible. Every mindful decision is an investment in your emotional well-being,
financial security, and future.

modules.title: Awareness & Commitment
focus: I recognize the difference between my needs and my impulses.
I choose intentional spending over emotional buying.
Every thoughtful decision strengthens my self-control.

modules.title: Healing & Self-Compassion
focus: My value comes from who I am, not from what I own.
I forgive my past and build a healthier future.
I learn healthy ways to respond to difficult emotions.

modules.title: Strength & Growth
focus: I make financial decisions with wisdom and patience.
Healthy habits are replacing impulsive behaviors.
I become stronger with every mindful choice.

modules.title: Freedom & Purpose
focus: I build a life centered on gratitude, purpose, and balance.
My financial choices reflect my values and goals.
I embrace a future of contentment, generosity, and lasting well-being.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by my possessions or my past spending habits. I am defined by my wisdom, my
values, and my commitment to living with purpose. Every day I choose mindful spending, I
strengthen my confidence, protect my financial future, and discover that true fulfillment comes from
meaningful relationships, personal growth, gratitude, and inner peace. One choice, one day, and one
step at a time, I am creating a life of balance, freedom, and lasting contentment.

fields.label: What will you keep practising after this journey?
What support do you still want?
Share this closing plan with Gerald
